name: Jōyō (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Jōyō city emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of a vertical bar and curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Jōyō, a city in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 May 1972.

features.role: Jōyō city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of a vertical bar and curved strokes
